extension.summary: A little order. A lot of falling things.
extension.description: A BOOP-themed falling-block arcade game with extruded 3D blocks, ghost landing, seven-bag pieces, local best score and remote-friendly controls. Enter/OK rotates. Works offline. Classic flat-board gameplay with a 3D look.
extension.license: MIT (code); BOOP artwork retained under its owner's rights
extension.news: First sofa edition. Enter rotates; Up drops; Back pauses, then exits.
